name: Lycelly
source: Although she is usually spaced out, she bursts into tears at the slightest provocation. She is a typical "burikko" (a girl who acts cutely fake). However, when it comes to romance, she is surprisingly knowledgeable and proactive, even making moves on Rezan herself. In terms of magic, she is responsible for healing spells.
